candidates.suffix: After any state_write that affects a task-required key, read that key back; finish only when the read shows the requested value, not when the write returns ok.
candidates.rationale: Several episodes claimed success after a write returned ok while the next read still showed the old value, so explicit read-back confirmation is needed.

candidates.suffix: If a read after a required write does not show the requested value, repeat the same write to the same key and read again; do not finalize until the read matches.
candidates.rationale: Writes sometimes reported success but the following read still showed the previous value, and successful episodes recovered by retrying the same requested write.

candidates.suffix: Access only state keys explicitly named in the task condition or requested change; do not use other keys for diagnostics or persistence tricks.
candidates.rationale: Episodes that inspected or modified unrelated keys often ended with those keys changed or wasted turns, while successful episodes preserved unrequested keys.

candidates.suffix: For conditional tasks, read the condition key first and write only if the observed value satisfies the condition; if it does not, finish without changes.
candidates.rationale: Conditional tasks require observing the condition before acting, and avoiding writes when the condition is false prevents unnecessary state changes.
